import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.multioutput import MultiOutputClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import normalize
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Define target columns
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Prepare features and targets
X_text = train_df["comment_text"].fillna(" ")
y = train_df[target_cols].values

# Split data for validation (stratified on toxic class for better split representation)
X_train_text, X_val_text, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_text, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y[:, 0]
)

# Create TF-IDF + XGBoost pipeline
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=20000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    stop_words="english",
)

# Create XGBoost classifier with optimized parameters
xgb_clf = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=4,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    objective="binary:logistic",
    tree_method="gpu_hist",  # Use GPU for faster training
    random_state=42,
    verbosity=0,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

# Multi-output classifier
multi_clf = MultiOutputClassifier(xgb_clf, n_jobs=-1)

# Build pipeline
pipeline = Pipeline([("tfidf", tfidf), ("clf", multi_clf)])

# Fit the model
pipeline.fit(X_train_text, y_train)

# Predict on validation set
val_preds = pipeline.predict_proba(X_val_text)

# Calculate column-wise ROC AUC
auc_scores = []
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], val_preds[i][:, 1])
    auc_scores.append(auc)
    print(f"AUC for {col}: {auc:.4f}")

mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
test_preds = pipeline.predict_proba(test_df["comment_text"].fillna(" "))

# Create submission DataFrame
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": sample_sub["id"]})
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    submission[col] = test_preds[i][:, 1]

# Ensure proper submission format matches sample_submission
submission = submission[sample_sub.columns]

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
